system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the grow-only counter CRDT specification. It extends the base CRDT specification and applies the finite monotonic technique: after each action, all counter values are reduced by the global minimum, keeping the state space finite while preserving the relevant system properties. It uses an experimental action composition feature to combine base actions with the reduction step.
actors_and_components: Same as the base CRDT specification: a set of distributed nodes maintaining local views of counter values. This module adds a reduction step that is composed with the original actions.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the base CRDT specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the base CRDT specification: all counter values are zero across all nodes' views.
actions: This module defines augmented versions of the base actions that compose each original action with a reduction step: (1) Increment-and-reduction: after incrementing a node's own counter, all counter values across all nodes' views are reduced by the minimum value found across the entire counter matrix. (2) Gossip-and-reduction: after merging counter vectors via gossip, the same global minimum reduction is applied. The next-state relation includes both the original unmodified actions and the composed versions, allowing the reduction to fire or not. A state constraint also limits each node's own counter value to at most three.
safety_properties: Inherits from the base CRDT specification: type correctness (all values are natural numbers in the expected structure) and safety (each node has the most up-to-date view of its own counter).
liveness_properties: Convergence: all nodes eventually reach identical counter vectors. This is checked as a temporal property. Note that monotonicity cannot be checked because the reduction step (subtracting the global minimum) intentionally decreases counter values, which violates the monotonicity property from the base specification.
model_bounds: The set of nodes is configured as a finite set of three nodes. Each node's own counter value is constrained to be at most three via a state constraint. The specification requires the experimental action composition feature to be enabled in TLC. The fair specification (with fairness assumptions) is used.
additional_assumptions: This module requires an experimental TLC feature for action composition (sequential composition of actions within a single transition). The reduction step computes the global minimum across all counter entries for all node pairs, then subtracts that minimum from every entry. This transposition keeps counter values bounded while preserving the relative differences that matter for correctness. The monotonicity property is intentionally excluded from checking because the reduction violates it by design.
